claim: Try it with sample data loads eight notes in a separate demo and never saves them to the real take shelf.
where: Landing action, demo banner, README, privacy page
sandbox: Fresh browser context; enter from the landing page, inspect both IndexedDB namespaces, reset, and start for real.

claim: Cleanup extends CC64-held notes and cuts a repeated pitch at the next strike without moving its start or velocity, including when the take ends with the pedal down.
where: Landing headline, workspace repair explanation, README
sandbox: Fresh demo followed by the verifier's two-C4 held-pedal session; assert visible cuts and exact exported cleaned note boundaries, starts, and velocities.

claim: Imports Standard MIDI type 0 and type 1 files.
sandbox: Fresh real workspace; import generated valid type 0 and type 1 fixtures and assert each parsed note is shown.

claim: Records notes and CC64 from a compatible Web MIDI input when the browser supports it and permission is granted.
where: Input controls, device section, privacy page, README
sandbox: Fresh browser context with a deterministic Web MIDI input fixture; connect, select, record note and CC64 messages, and assert the captured take.

claim: Scores note starts against the nearest sixteenth-note grid.
sandbox: Fresh demo; assert the sample's score, mean start offset, on-grid count, and stated subdivision.

claim: Replays the cleaned take and raises the next replay tempo by the selected step up to the finish BPM.
sandbox: Fresh demo; set Start 240, Finish 245, and Step 5, complete one replay, and assert the next BPM is 245.

claim: Exports the cleaned take as a free Standard MIDI file.
sandbox: Fresh demo; export the sample and assert the download name and Standard MIDI MThd header.

claim: Exports and restores one session or the complete take shelf as JSON.
where: Session export, take shelf backup controls, README
sandbox: Fresh demo; download session and all-takes JSON, enter the empty real workspace, then restore both and assert the take.

claim: Saves take history and cleanup acceptance on this device through refresh, with deletion available.
where: Take shelf, cleanup acceptance, device section, privacy page, README
sandbox: Fresh real workspace; import and accept a take, reload, assert both states, then confirm deletion and inspect IndexedDB.

claim: The cached demo, replay, and cleaned MIDI export work offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Dedicated browser context; install from /demo, go offline, reload, replay, and assert a valid MIDI download.

claim: MIDI processing and storage stay on the device with no analytics, tracking, third-party scripts, or font requests.
where: Landing facts, device section, footer, privacy page, README
sandbox: Record every request across a fresh demo cleanup and verify every URL and script origin is the product origin.

claim: This build has no account, purchase, subscription, checkout, or feature gate.
sandbox: Fresh landing page; assert no billing or account action exists and live MIDI remains enabled.
